description:
FILED s532c (Opus agent, 2026-11-06), the board hunt of #4087 (Template-Toolkit parser.t row 35 "template text 12").  NOT FIXED: it is a PPI tokenizer row -- the next PPI batch's (vendor/PPI `pcl` branch, `Pl/PPIBugs.pm`, `docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md` + `docs/ppi-bug-report.t`, rule 13).

    my $s = eval "'a\r\nb'";   print length($s), "\n";   # perl 4, PCL 3
    my $t = eval "\"a\r\nb\""; print length($t), "\n";   # perl 4, PCL 3
    my $v = eval "q{a\r\r\nb}"; print length($v), "\n";  # perl 5, PCL 3
  (a lone CR is rewritten to LF too: same length, different character)

PPI 1.292 (vendored, vendor/PPI/lib/PPI/Tokenizer.pm:209, in `new`):
    $self->{source} =~ s/(?:\015{1,2}\012|\015|\012)/\n/g;
  Token dump: PPI::Document->new(\"my \$x = q{a\r\nb};\nmy \$y = \"c\rd\";\n") gives
    PPI::Token::Quote::Literal [q{a<LF>b}]   (expected q{a<CR><LF>b})
    PPI::Token::Quote::Double  ["c<LF>d"]    (expected "c<CR>d")
  perl's toke.c translates nothing on Unix: a CR inside a string literal, a heredoc body or the __DATA__ section is a character of the program.

WHERE IT BITES: Template::Toolkit compiles a template to Perl text with Data::Dumper-like single-quoted strings that carry the template's characters verbatim; `[% wintxt | replace("(\r\n){2,}", "\n<break>\n") %]` becomes `'(' CR LF '){2,}'`, PCL's string eval reads `(\n){2,}` and the replace never matches (expect "=foo\n<break>\nbar...", got "=foo\r\n\r\nbar...").  A Windows-edited source file's __DATA__ section loses its CRs the same way (perl keeps them).
FIX SHAPE (for the PPI batch): the normalization is PPI's line-splitting convenience; a fix keeps the CRs in token content (split on /(?<=\n)/ without rewriting, and teach the line/column counters a CR LF line end) -- measure PPI's own suite, it may lean on the rewrite.  Row: Template-Toolkit-3.106-0 parser.t 35 (#4302).

=== s536j (PPI batch 8): MEASURED, NOT FIXED -- the rest is #4761 ===
Catalogued as docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §65 (registry row 65, fixed_in undef; report rows 408-411 inside a PCL §65 TODO block on branch pcl, ae78574f).  Measured: dropping PPI::Tokenizer::new's rewrite (split on LF only) fails exactly one row of PPI's own suite, t/06_round_trip.t 2146 (t/perf.t has CR LF line ends; the test normalizes its expected text with the same regex, t/06_round_trip.t:76; t/08_regression.t:270 too) -- the rewrite is PPI behaviour its tests assert, so the fix is a Document attribute or a behaviour change, plus perl's CR rules in PCL's lowering (probed: file mode converts the CR LF at line ends inside multi-line literals and here-docs; eval mode keeps every CR in literals but converts here-docs; __DATA__ raw).  #4761 holds the design, the probe files and the bar.  TT parser.t row 35 one-file run unchanged (still this cause).
subject: SILENT WRONG (PPI): PPI's tokenizer rewrites every CR LF, CR CR LF and lone CR in the SOURCE to LF, so a literal CR inside a quote / heredoc / __DATA__ is lost -- perl keeps it (TT t/parser.t row 35: a template's generated Perl holds '(\r\n){2,}' as real CR LF characters)
